brief.t: START HERE: Open the IPFS cancellation notice and check payment records, then contact the existing LIMN broker contact to verify coverage and the cure balance.

ACT NOW 1: Verify insurance payment and prevent cancellation. IPFS October 23 intent-to-cancel notice lists $941.41 and a November 5, 5 pm Central cure deadline for financed general liability coverage. Original payment due October 13: 11 calendar days past due on notice; actual unpaid balance must be confirmed. Original due date 11 days ago; cure deadline November 5, 6 pm Eastern. Send: Please confirm whether the IPFS payment has cleared and our coverage remains active, and give me the verified balance and cure action today.

ACT NOW 2: Expedite Oreka SenoCellTec and protect sample window. Michael requested an ingredient update October 23. Mibelle confirmation 5502341 for 1 kg SenoCellTec shows November 3 delivery, FCA Mahwah and advance payment. Nadia CRM task asks for Canada delivery while she is there until November 1. Confirmation is not shipment evidence. Lab request 1 day old; CRM reply task due October 14, 10 days ago; Canada window ends November 1. Send: Please confirm the earliest SenoCellTec dispatch, whether November 3 is a ship or arrival date, and any payment hold, as we need to protect a sample delivery window before November 1.

ACT NOW 3: Verify TALOVA rework before release. October 23 agenda identifies a batch requiring salvage, an undocumented rework procedure and independent verification still needed. Marcello FBA requests date to October 20. USPS collected 60 pieces yesterday but there is no order match proving those FBA shipments shipped. Rework plan 1 day old, no firm completion deadline; Marcello waiting 4 calendar days. Send: Aaron and Ron, please send the affected TALOVA batch IDs, rework results and independent verification plan so we can confirm usable inventory and shipment dates.

next: Recommendation: Verify insurance cure first, expedite Oreka second, then establish TALOVA quality release.

Displaced: Mothered and Polo leave the top three for the confirmed insurance notice and Oreka date conflict. Mothered independent procedure verification is planned for next week, not complete; Polo rail appointment remains unconfirmed.

Scheduled: 19 active Aidan CRM task records, 17 dated before today, 1 due October 26 and 1 undated; completion is unverified. Nearest upcoming deadline: validate the reported 21 ingredient shortages for Men’s Moisturizer, Monday October 26. Customer pricing remains with Sam.
Noise: 19 non-operational messages suppressed from 41 new inbound messages.

Both lane reports received under cmd_20261024_0700_et_status. Email completed a read-only mailbox review; no recent substantive draft found. Purchasing blocked: no fresh supplier/PO/QC records; missing evidence is not zero or clearance. Mothered draft process remains unverified, independent verifier/date unassigned in mailbox evidence, and the requested October 23 ingredient-order date is 1 day past; Sam owns customer contact. Polo payment receipt and rail appointment remain unverified; do not pay twice. CRM and WhatsApp findings above are from the original morning review, not rechecked in this reconciliation. Insurance/Oreka follow-up requests are now reported sent with Sent Items verification; see latest update. No purchases, payments, customer messages or CRM changes made.

Email lane reports both follow-ups sent and verified in Sent Items: Mibelle at 07:13:19 EDT for earlier dispatch, November 3 date clarification and payment application; trusted broker Jake at 07:13:25 EDT for IPFS payment/coverage/cure verification. Supplier acknowledged advance payment October 14; application and balance still await confirmation. Neither shipment timing nor insurance clearance is confirmed. No payment, purchase, extra cost or customer email authorized. Sam escalation remains undelivered: Aidan switchboard supports consultant, purchasing and email only, no Sam target. Aidan must raise the sample-window risk and insurance warning with Sam through an approved human channel.
